name: Adobe Illustrator API
description: Illustrator automation for Adobe Firefly Services (image.adobe.io): an IllustratorPort + adapter for artboard rendering, variable-data merge, and vector scaling (vector→raster at arbitrary scale — ads to billboards) over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async.

questions.prompt: Which Illustrator operations will you use?

checklist: Confirm the Illustrator API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project (same IMS Server-to-Server auth as Firefly)
Verify the current endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — the Illustrator API lives on image.adobe.io (same host family as Photoshop/Lightroom; the client posts absolute URLs there)
Provide presigned input (.ai) + output hrefs (and a data source for dataMerge) — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
Vector→raster at arbitrary scale: pass scale / width / height on the request; default output format is ADOBE_ILLUSTRATOR_FORMAT (set at install)
